nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable, set to msg.sender in constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
Public boolean state variable of Pausable indicating whether the external manager contract is paused.
Public string state variable holding the registry version '1.3.0'.
Public uint counter of registered stores, incremented in setAStore.
Public mapping (bytes32 => address) from keccak256 app nickname to store contract address.
Public address of the manager contract; cast to Pausable and called externally in isReady.
Public address of the claimer contract used by the registry readiness check.
bytes32 key keccak256('manager') used in ContractRegistered events.
bytes32 key keccak256('claimer') used in ContractRegistered events.
bytes32 key keccak256('store') used in ContractRegistered events.
Constructor of Ownable that assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
Payable constructor of HasNoEther requiring msg.value == 0 to reject incoming Ether.
Non-payable fallback function of HasNoEther that reverts on plain Ether transfers.
Owner-only function sending the whole contract balance to owner via send(this.balance).
Owner-only function setting the manager address and emitting ContractRegistered.
Owner-only function setting the claimer address and emitting ContractRegistered.
Owner-only function setting both manager and claimer addresses in one call.
Owner-only function registering a store for an app nickname and incrementing totalStores for new entries.
Public constant function returning the store address associated with an app nickname.
Public constant function checking totalStores, manager, claimer and the manager's paused() flag.
Caller address controlled by the user; used for ownership assignment and authorization checks.
Low-level send of the entire contract balance to owner inside reclaimEther (external value transfer).
External call to the untrusted manager contract address via Pausable interface inside isReady.
State-changing ownership reassignment guarded only by the onlyOwner modifier and a zero-address check.
Authorization check in the onlyOwner modifier comparing the untrusted caller with the stored owner.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the address of the new owner.
Parameter of setManager holding the new manager contract address.
Parameter of setClaimer holding the new claimer contract address.
Parameter of setAStore holding the app nickname used as mapping key.
Parameter of setAStore holding the store contract address to register.
Local variable in isReady holding the manager address cast to the Pausable interface.

edges.reason: msg.sender from the Ownable constructor is written into the owner state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against the stored owner inside the onlyOwner authorization check.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of reclaimEther.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setManager.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setClaimer.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setManagerAndClaimer.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setAStore.
Parameter newOwner is consumed by transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is the source value of the owner reassignment operation.
Ownership reassignment writes the owner state variable.
Stored owner address is the recipient of the balance transfer in reclaimEther.
reclaimEther executes the owner.send(this.balance) external value transfer.
Parameter _manager is consumed by setManager.
setManager writes the manager state variable.
Parameter _claimer is consumed by setClaimer.
setClaimer writes the claimer state variable.
Parameter _manager is consumed by setManagerAndClaimer.
Parameter _claimer is consumed by setManagerAndClaimer.
setManagerAndClaimer writes the manager state variable.
setManagerAndClaimer writes the claimer state variable.
Parameter _appNickname is used as the mapping key in setAStore.
Parameter _store is the value written into the stores mapping by setAStore.
setAStore writes stores[keccak256(_appNickname)] = _store.
setAStore increments totalStores without overflow protection in Solidity 0.4.x.
setAStore calls getStore to check for an existing registration.
Parameter _appNickname is consumed by getStore.
getStore reads the stores mapping to return the registered store address.
manager state variable is cast to the Pausable interface stored in local variable pausable.
Local pausable instance is the receiver of the external paused() call.
isReady performs the external call pausable.paused() on the manager contract.
External paused() call reads the paused state variable of the manager contract.
isReady reads totalStores in its readiness condition.
isReady reads the manager address for its readiness condition.
isReady reads the claimer address for its readiness condition.
HasNoEther constructor disables payable reception together with the non-payable fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner exists only as the input of transferOwnership and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter _manager exists only as the input of setManager and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter _claimer exists only as the input of setClaimer and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter _appNickname of setAStore is only used as the mapping key inside that core function.
Parameter _store of setAStore is only written into the stores mapping inside that core function.
Local variable pausable is only the cast receiver used by the core function isReady.
